name: session_prepare
description: Read a Python or JSON source and begin an inspectable staged editing session.

steps.purpose: Inspect the current read contract and read the selected file; retain its source_sha256.
Inspect the opt-in session tool's contract, root and path requirements and limits.
Begin with the explicit absolute root, relative file path and observed source_sha256. Retain the returned session ID and revision; preserve any prior staged work on failure.
Show the session using its ID and current revision. Page through staged text before choosing an exact replacement.

limits: Guidance only. Requires explicit access to the read and opt-in session tools. Sessions are local evidence, not a sandbox or a filesystem authorization mechanism.
